name: Regent Beijing
insider_take: This luxurious haven sits in the heart of Beijing's prestigious Wangfujing district, where imperial history meets modern sophistication.
whats_special: The Regent Beijing occupies a prime location just steps from the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square. The hotel features one of Beijing's most acclaimed Cantonese restaurants, Jinbao 99, and houses an impressive collection of contemporary Chinese art throughout its elegant interiors.
pro_tip: Book a room on the higher floors facing west for stunning views of the Forbidden City's golden rooftops, especially magical during sunset.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature afternoon tea service featuring traditional Chinese delicacies, and take advantage of being within walking distance of Wangfujing's famous night food market and the historic Donghuamen area.
pros: Prime location in Wangfujing district near Forbidden City and shopping
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
Luxurious spacious rooms and suites with premium amenities
Award-winning restaurants featuring authentic Chinese and international cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Located in busy commercial district with heavy foot traffic
